summary: Backend-only testing for Telegram video cover-parameter fix. Ran the provided monkeypatch unit test (/app/backend/test_cover_param.py) — BOTH scenarios PASSED: (a) cover attached via multipart alongside 320px thumbnail; (b) graceful retry WITHOUT cover when old Local Bot API returns ok:false. Verified telegram_api exposes new functions (extract_cover, edit_message_caption, edit_message_text) and that send_video_file accepts `cover` kwarg and send_media_group_files reads item['cover']. Confirmed backend imports cleanly, supervisor RUNNING. Regression pytest suite (4 tests) via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: login → JWT, GET /api/stats, GET /api/posts, GET /api/channels — all 200. No regressions detected. Note: real ffmpeg/Telegram publishing cannot be exercised in preview (ffmpeg absent, no bot token) — by design extract_cover returns None gracefully in that case.
critical_code_review_comments: send_video_file/send_media_group_files fallback logic looks correct: `ok:false` triggers a single retry without the cover field, preserving publishing reliability against older Local Bot API servers.
extract_cover returns None when ffmpeg is missing — safe no-op in preview env; caller must (and does) handle None.
File handles opened for cover in _post are closed in the finally block alongside other files — no leak observed.

Consider narrowing the fallback trigger: currently ANY ok:false retries without cover; if the failure was unrelated (e.g., chat_not_found), the second attempt will also fail but the extra call is harmless. Optionally inspect response['description'] for 'cover' substring before retrying.
context_for_next_testing_agent: cover-parameter wiring is validated only via monkeypatch (ffmpeg + real bot token unavailable in preview). Full end-to-end validation must happen on user's VPS. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_cover_regression.py for future dashboard regression checks; run cover unit test with: cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend python test_cover_param.py
